# Bait Baazi

> AI-powered Urdu Bait Baazi platform. Browse Ahmadiyya Muslim Jamat shair by starting and ending letter, search the library, and play against an AI opponent.

## Pages
- [Home](/): Overview, featured shair, alphabet quick-jump
- [Browse letters](/browse): All 36 Urdu letters, start or end mode
- [Search](/search): Full-text Urdu poetry search
- [Play](/play): Bait Baazi game against an AI opponent
